messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert: streaming-api p99 latency spike detected for region-eu-west. Alerts threshold crossed (p99 > 1.2s) at 2026-11-12T02:15:00Z. Paging on-call.

sarah_onsite: I'm on it. seeing increased tail stalls in stream sessions -> spikes in end-to-end RTT and TLS handshake retries. Starting triage. pinging @mike_infra for cross-zone routing checks and @nina_sre for SRE runbook.

mike_infra: on call. quick snapshot from the edge LB -> backend path shows higher retransmits crossing az boundaries. Looks like packets retransmit around 30% for some AZ pairs. Collecting tcpdump from a representative host.

sarah_onsite: copy. Metrics: p95 ~ 280ms (ok), p99 ~ 1.6s (breach), streaming stall count increased x8 in last 20m. Attachting traces (short ids): trace/aae2f3 -> shows repeated TLS handshake timeouts followed by reconnects.

nina_sre: grabbing runbook: "interzone-network-latency". Step 1: confirm scope. Are we seeing NAT port exhaustion or a routing flap? @mike_infra any NAT/gateway errors?

mike_infra: NAT metrics look normal on the surface (open ports ~50%). However, we see bursty SYN retransmit rates on the transit route between azb and azc. BGP adjacency stable. Starting flow logs and capturing iperf test across AZs.

sarah_onsite: here's a representative stacktrace/log from a stalled session:
```
[2026-11-12T02:18:03Z] connection_id=xyz session=start tls: handshake timeout after 1200ms
[2026-11-12T02:18:05Z] connection_id=xyz session=retry tls: handshake ok, stream init delayed 900ms
```

rcook: I see a pattern — TCP retransmits spike on packets carrying TLS ClientHello. Could be MTU black-holing or mid-path packet loss for larger TLS packets. Any new firewall rules or WAF changes deployed recently?

deploy-bot: No changes to WAF/firewall in last 24h in eu-west region. Last infra deploy: 2026-11-11T21:04:12Z (id: infra-7721) - config diff minimal.

mike_infra: I kicked off a targeted tcpdump and ran `sudo tcpreplay` style synthetic traffic. Observed 1.3% packet loss at L3 between azb->azc on a subset of VLANs during the incident window. Reproduced higher TLS handshake durations with larger ClientHello (SNI + ALPN) packets.

sarah_onsite: mitigation proposal: 1) route streaming control-plane traffic to same-AZ backends where possible (temporary affinity), 2) enable fallback cipher suites to reduce ClientHello size, 3) put a temporary proxy in-region to collapse cross-zone handshake roundtrips. Which do we want to prioritize?

nina_sre: Start with low blast: (1) apply AZ affinity at LB for new sessions for 10m canary. That avoids cross-zone path for most new streams. (2) CS comms to customers about degraded tail latency. I'll run canary and monitor p99.

mike_infra: applying LB session affinity via route override now (one-off command):
```
$ rdxctl route override --service streaming-api --region eu-west --override az_affinity=prefer_local --ttl 600
```
Status: rollout started to edge nodes (20% -> 100% in 3m). Watch metrics.

sarah_onsite: metrics update 02:24Z: p99 dropped from 1.6s -> 980ms within 5 minutes of canary. Streaming stalls reduced by ~60% on canary hosts. Good signal.

cs_ops: preparing customer notification. Draft: "We detected intermittent increases in streaming tail latency affecting connections across availability zones in eu-west. We've applied a mitigation that significantly reduced impact. We're continuing root cause analysis and will follow up." Want me to send now? cc @sarah_onsite

sarah_onsite: send now. include note: "no data loss, reconnects possible for small percentage, rolling mitigation in place." Also ask customers to report any ongoing stalled sessions.

rcook: continue digging for root cause. Hypothesis: intermittent cross-AZ fabric congestion triggered by an external burst or vendor-side queueing causing MTU fragmentation/retransmits. I'll request packet captures from fabric provider and check egress gateways for buffer drops.

mike_infra: requested extra telemetry from provider. Also spinning up a small proxy cluster in eu-west to terminate TLS closer to edge (keeps ClientHello small path) as secondary mitigation if affinity oscillates.

nina_sre: shift handoff: I'm taking on primary oncall for next 2 hours. @sarah_onsite handed off all context. If affinity rollback needed, I'll coordinate. Who's owning follow-up RCA?

sarah_onsite: I can lead RCA with @rcook and @mike_infra. We'll sync postmortem notes in #postmortems channel and include timeline, metrics, packet captures, and communication log.

deploy-bot: Automated note: rollout complete: route override removed on test edge nodes? Actually currently at 100% per earlier command. No new deploys.

nina_sre: re p99 right now at 750ms and stall count near baseline. Keeping this thread open for RCA. If telemetry from provider shows packet drops at provider, escalate to SRE leadership. Closing immediate paging. :white_check_mark:

sarah_onsite: thanks everyone. Recording action items: 1) RCA (sarah/rcook/mike) 2) provider packet logs (mike) 3) postmortem draft (nina) 4) customer follow-up (cs_ops). I'll add links to artifacts in thread when available.

incident-bot: Incident page created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1829004500 - severity: S2 - customer impact: degraded tail latency for streaming sessions in eu-west - mitigation: AZ affinity applied (temporary).
